items.headline: ASML earnings boost tech stocks as AI demand exceeds near-term equipment capacity
items.summary: ASML reported AI-driven demand for chipmaking tools strong enough that it expected difficulty fully meeting customer demand in 2027 and 2028, raised its full-year sales outlook, and planned capacity expansion.

items.headline: Chip stocks wobbled as investors reassessed AI spending returns
items.summary: Semiconductor shares weakened amid concern that market profitability is concentrated in a small group of AI-chip and hyperscaler companies; Broadcom CEO Hock Tan publicly questioned the return on some AI expenditure.

items.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang remains optimistic on AI opportunity and European adoption
items.summary: Jensen Huang described the AI era as an opportunity for Europe and discussed AI risks, sovereignty, jobs, and the scale of current AI usage.
